dedupe_keys.name: entso e transparency platform european electricity generation load transmission and balancing data

description: The ENTSO-E Transparency Platform is the central European publication point for fundamental electricity market data. It was launched on 5 January 2015 under Commission Regulation (EU) No 543/2013, which made it mandatory for data providers and owners in the Member States to submit information on electricity generation, load, transmission and balancing for publication there. Data come from transmission system operators, power exchanges and other qualified third parties, and are defined in the Detailed Data Descriptions of the Manual of Procedures. Categories follow the regulation: generation, load, transmission and balancing, with views such as cross-border physical flows in the transmission domain. Historical data from 2011 to 2014, earlier published on entsoe.net, can also be downloaded. Coverage is the ENTSO-E area in Europe, by bidding zone, control area and country. Data are free to view; the API needs a registered account and security token. Since February 2019 TSOs release their data under an open data licence; data from other owners follow their own policies. Caveats: data are published close to real time and are not intended as statistics, and completeness varies by area and provider. Simulation uses are demand, generation and flow inputs for European grid and market models and stress event analysis. Related records: data-open-power-system-data repackages some of these series, and data-entsoe-power-statistics gives aggregated statistics.
